name: Covance Softsol Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2023, Covance SoftSol Ltd provides services related to software development and information technology[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CSL provides end-to-end solutions for data transformation, business process optimization, and enterprise applications using cloud, AI, ML, and data analytics. The company emphasizes intuitive UX/UI design and holds CMMi Level 3, ISO 9001, and ISO 27001 certifications. It is also an AWS and Microsoft Gold Certified Partner.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.7.99 Cr.
